layout: Room 1 spectra, Room 1 time, Room 2 spectra, Room 2 time; recorded-clap / inferred-RIR columns throughout
spectrum_normalization: Original spectral convention: squared 39690-point FFT magnitude divided by each signal mean FFT-bin power over 0.1--10 kHz; 1/12-octave mean linear power, then 10 log10. No spectral-peak normalization.
waveform_normalization: None: RMS of original digital samples, fixed amplitude reference 1
rms_boundary: Centered window clipped to available source support, divided by actual sample count; no zero padding. The 250-ms point uses the full saved waveform.
waveform_db_definition: 20 log10(RMS), fixed digital amplitude reference 1 and numerical amplitude floor 1e-12; no envelope-peak division
waveform_alignment: unchanged input-onset alignment; no prediction-dependent shift
display_calibration: Temporal panels preserve original digital levels, not calibrated SPL; RMS dBFS uses digital full scale 1 for every curve. Spectra retain the original per-signal mean-power normalization.
pdf_raster_review: Full PDFs independently rasterized with Ghostscript at 145 dpi and inspected. All eight panels, shared axes, letters, and legend are readable without overlap.
